prism.title: PRISM lens
prism.body: Your goals read against your own PRISM profile — which ones lean on a strength, which ask for a stretch.

progress.title: Progress
progress.body: Milestones and check-ins against each goal, with your coach's reviews beside them.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: A résumé, bio or profile drafted from your real history and goals — never from a template career.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.sub: These three panels are planned. They will read your own data or they will not show at all.

job_mentor.focus: Current-role excellence — performance, team dynamics, job-specific skills, day-to-day productivity.

career_coach.focus: Strategic advancement — next-role prep, pivots, leadership development, positioning, long-term trajectory.

prism_coach.focus: Behavioral effectiveness — stress, adaptability, communication style, conflict, emotional intelligence.

coaches.callout: You always hear one voice. Behind Meridian, Echo and Forge build current-role skill, Nova and Ascend plan advancement, and Aura works the behavioral foundations — each seeing only the goals routed to them.
coaches.title: Your coaching team
coaches.sub: Goals Studio doesn't coach the goals itself — it hands each one to the specialist who owns that kind of growth, then Meridian brings their work back to you in one voice.

interview.title: Talk it through with Goals Studio
interview.sub: Five areas of your working life, a category at a time, with the WHY ladder underneath each stated goal. Voice leads; text is one toggle away.

ladder.rung1: “I want to get better at leading through change.”
ladder.rung2: Why does that feel important right now?
ladder.rung3: The reorg keeps shifting and my team looks to me for answers.
ladder.rung4: What makes having the answers matter so much to you?
ladder.rung5: If I hesitate, they'll think I don't have it together.
ladder.rung6: And why is that particular thing hard to sit with?
ladder.rung7: Not a skill to acquire — protecting how the team sees you under pressure. That's what the goal hooks onto.

discovery.title: Discovery, not a questionnaire
discovery.sub: Goals Studio gathers organically across sessions. For each category it explores, probes for patterns, runs the WHY ladder to your true motivation, then converts the discussion into candidate goals.
discovery.error: We couldn't read your progress just now. Refresh to try again — nothing you've worked through has been lost.
discovery.underneath: What sits underneath what you said you wanted
discovery.howItWorks: How it works · the WHY ladder
discovery.howHeading: How "better leadership" becomes a real goal
discovery.howBody: We don't stop at the first answer. Asking "why" a few times reaches the motivation the goal actually hooks onto. This is an example of the shape it takes — yours will be in your own words.

dashboard.brainCallout: Every goal here is aligned to your brain map: we prefer goals that leverage your natural strengths, and we frame any stretch as a conscious, time-boxed adaptation — never a permanent rewrite of who you are.
dashboard.titleNamed: Let's turn the conversation into goals, {{name}}.
dashboard.title: Let's turn the conversation into goals.
dashboard.sub: Goals Studio works through five areas of your life, asks why until it reaches something you actually care about, and turns that into goals with the reason still attached.

sharing.title: Who can see my goals and PRISM profile
sharing.sub: Nobody sees your goals or your PRISM profile by rank. You share each with a specific person for a year, can renew, and can take it back at any time. Turning a switch on renews the term for a year. A goal you mark private stays hidden even from them.
sharing.previewNote: A preview of their view. Nothing on it can be clicked here.
sharing.previewEmpty: Publish a goal and it will show here exactly as a person you share with sees it.
